# Papyrus build sources

The Diziet bath patch compiles against source scripts from its supported mods.
These files are build inputs and are not included in the package.

- `diziet/dz_undress_MCM_menu_script.psc` comes from
  [Diziet's Player Home Bath Undressing 7.1.2.7](https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/30265).
  Diziet permits reuse when psychoslaphead is credited.
- `bathing-in-skyrim/mzinBatheQuest.psc` comes from
  [Bathing in Skyrim Special Edition 1.43](https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/23730).
  The original Bathing in Skyrim author permits reuse without restriction.
  Credit goes to mz1n and TheRealRyanB.
